verdict.rationale: Vendor explicitly advertises debugging/troubleshooting via natural language (gh-3, gh-12), and some users praise its large-context codebase navigation (comm-1, comm-12). However, multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing at basic file edits, producing spaghetti code, and even destructive failures during agentic debugging tasks (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15, comm-16), directly contradicting the vendor claim.
